rows.en: What? You're blockin' our way!? You guys never come up with any new tricks, do ya!!
So you're the ones they call the Lost Heroes?
...You're not? You're heroes who've lost their power, aren't you?
And beings that lowly think they can compete with us Innovators!!
Are you really the ones Gaddess had so much trouble with?
Then I'll take you all down in one go!!
Looks like the Psycho Gundam Mk-II is running wild out on the outer wall.
Breaking right through the wall... That's quite something.
That's right... Heh, so you know it? You seem pretty scared of it.
That's the trouble with enhanced soldiers. Once they go berserk, there's no controlling them.
...So there was still a Psycho Gundam left.
...So there was still a Psycho Gundam left.
...So there was still a Psycho Gundam left.
...So there was still a Psycho Gundam left.
...So there was still a Psycho Gundam left.
...So there was still a Psycho Gundam left.
...So there was still a Psycho Gundam left.
...Psycho-whatsit!? So that big lug's still hangin' around!
That's the trouble with enhanced soldiers. Once they go berserk, there's no controlling them.
Now then! Let me come at you all over again!! Prepare yourselveees!!
Wh... Why!! There's no way we could ever lose!!
Garazzo, let's fall back for now.
Calm down!! ...Can't you hear the orders?
...Orders? Ah, right... the quantum brainwaves... Yeah... Let's fall back...
We'll call this one your victory. But I hear the particle cannon is about to fire.
Surely it won't miss this time. It's bound to crush your base.
Tch! Looks like a sturdy door.
This is... a defensive bulkhead. None of the weapons we have can even make a dent in it.

notes.note: #0.3-17: 15-slot leader block (TextIdOffset+2+k). Second Pt_Chara_Check chain in 0618.bla gives k order: 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O Sword (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1; the wording fits (0.15 rough = Momotaros, 0.7 'mobile suits, new model' = Zeta). Same order used for #0.25-39 and #0.99-113. #0.3 'omae-tachi' = Setsuna recognising the two Innovators: 'You two'.
Momotaros, to the Regis villains in general: 'same as ever, no imagination in what you do'.
#0.20-21 are not called by the event script (unused lines). #0.20 speaker unknown (likely a party member echoing); #0.21 read as Garazzo continuing #0.19.
Gadessa (Revive) uses boku; 'Innovators' is the term the Innovades use for themselves in 00, kept as the source's word.
Script plays #0.24 (Seravee's cry) before #0.23; translated each row as written.
Seravee, after Gadessa's 'What!?': read as pointing the party to the breach behind them ('Behind us!!'); could also be 'Behind you!!'.
'Psycho Gundam Mk-II' not in glossary; standard Zeta Gundam English name, ASCII hyphen.
Kyouka heishi rendered 'enhanced soldiers' (Gadessa's generic phrasing); not the glossary's kyouka ningen (Cyber-Newtype). #0.74 is the same line, identical English.

#0.60-73: leader lines reacting to the Mk-II (Zeta has its own #0.52; Momotaros #0.67 via Pt_Chara_Check 3). Variant-to-leader mapping inside this block not resolved; identical Japanese -> identical English. 'Still' = after the Psycho Gundam beaten earlier (0227).
Noryoshi-ha = quantum brainwaves (precedent 0252 #0.5); the 'orders' come from Ribbons via brainwaves (inferred).
'Next time it won't miss' -> 'won't miss this time' (the first shot missed, per 0616/0617 tremors and Cherudim's 'second shot' in story_115).
#0.99-113 block continues in story_115; #0.99-102 = 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu by the chain order.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped via the Pt_Chara_Check chain (00 first ... Rider 1 last). Uncertain: #0.45 'Behind us' vs 'Behind you'; #0.20 speaker unknown (unused line); kyouka heishi -> 'enhanced soldiers'. Not in glossary: Psycho Gundam Mk-II, Innovators, particle cannon, defensive bulkhead.
